title: Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Kifungu (Theme 5: Mimi na wenzangu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for three things: who, what happened in order, and what the passage teaches; then says them in his own words.

floor.prerequisite: Answers a who-question about a sentence he hears.
floor.question: Sikiliza: "Mama alipika ugali." Nani alipika?

representations: three picture cards of the events
the new word on a card with its sentence
a listening chart: Nani? Nini? Funzo?
steps: Say the message and use the new word.
contexts: a story told by the teacher

board.do: Kamau alisahau chakula, Otieno alimgawia, walikula pamoja
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child retells the passage with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.

misconceptions.repair: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tushiriki tulicho nacho na wenzetu.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi ilisema nini kabla na baada ya neno hilo?
misconceptions.repair: Katika kifungu, "kushiriki" ni kugawana kitu na mwenzako.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi yako inamwambia mwenzako nini kuhusu neno hili?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi nzuri inaonyesha maana ya neno.

listen_for: Walikula pamoja, Kamau alisahau chakula, Otieno alimgawia
misconceptions.repair: Matukio yalifuatana hivi: Kamau alisahau chakula, Otieno alimgawia, walikula pamoja.

misconceptions.ask: Je, jambo hilo lilikuwa kwenye kifungu?
misconceptions.repair: Kusimulia upya ni kusema yaliyokuwa kwenye kifungu tu.
